summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py, CHANGELOG.md, and tests/test_progress.py. Nothing was run (tests, mypy, black) and nothing was committed. Changes: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default off), a static render_speed(speed) method that scales with filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix, and a render branch for unknown totals using finished_speed or speed. The track() helper gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column. Progress.track now leaves the total as None for unsized sequences instead of raising. Tests: removed the two ValueError assertions in test_track and test_progress_track and added test_task_progress_column_speed. CHANGELOG has one new Added line. Unverified: strict mypy and black checks. Unexercised: the unsized non-iterable case has no test after the ValueError removal.
